text:
Predicates:
Visited(x, y) ::: x visited y.
MountainRange(y) ::: y is a mountain range.
LocatedIn(y, z) ::: y is located in z.
Mine(x) ::: x is a mine.
Donated(x) ::: x has been donated.
In(y, z) ::: y is in z.
HasMine(y, x) ::: y has mine x.
InTexas(y) ::: y is in Texas.
InNewMexico(y) ::: y is in New Mexico.
Premises:
PicurisMountains(Mountains) ∧ LocatedIn(Mountains, NewMexico ∨ Texas) ::: The Picuris Mountains are in New Mexico or Texas.
Visited(JuanDeOnate, Mountains) ::: Juan de Onate visited the Picuris Mountains.
LocatedIn(Mine, Mountains) ::: The Harding Pegmatite Mine is located in the Picuris Mountains.
Donated(Mine) ::: The Harding Pegmatite Mine was donated.
In(Texas, Mountains) ∧ ∃x (HasMine(Mountains, x) ∧ Donated(x)) ::: There are no mountain ranges in Texas with donated mines.
Conclusion:
Visited(JuanDeOnate, Texas)
